description: Use before buying, accepting or recommending a token. Returns SAFE, CAUTION or AVOID with the exact reasons, from on-chain data plus market data. Checks a token's on-chain powers (mint, freeze, Token-2022 traps), verification, liquidity, holder concentration and age, and turns them into one verdict. Inputs: mint: The token's mint address. network (optional): Solana cluster to read. Defaults to "mainnet-beta" (real funds). Cost: 25 free calls a day, then $0.02 USDC per call (x402). Full field-by-field docs: GET /api/tools/token_verdict.
name: token_verdict
